summary: Injured hiker found in difficult-to-access terrain near Old Stage Road; ground team reached them on foot, then the Colorado Army National Guard hoisted them to additional medical care.
location: Vicinity of Old Stage Road, southwest of Colorado Springs
responding_agency: El Paso County Search and Rescue
notes: Post dated 9/8 says 'Friday evening' (2024-09-06). Assisted by Colorado Army National Guard, Canon Helitack, Colorado SAR Association.
